items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used to tell everybody that I knew that the best drummer that I ever heard, as far as this whole kind of idea of music, is Kenny Clarke.

ctx.x: Yeah two fantastic drummers. And again I was always- I used to tell everybody that I knew that the best drummer that I ever heard, as far as this whole kind of idea of music, is Kenny Clarke. He’s the granddaddy of all this music. And you know, he played decent piano as well.
What about his style do you think was so different or so innovative?
